notes: Researched the original Sequential Prophet-6 (49-key analog synthesizer, first released 2015 as Dave Smith Instruments, now sold under Sequential). Primary source: manufacturer's official Prophet-6 Operation Manual v2.1 (Feb 2021), "Connections" section pp.10-12, which numbers and describes each rear-panel jack (https://sequential.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/02/Prophet-6-Operation-Manual-2.1.pdf). Cross-checked against the manufacturer product page (https://sequential.com/product/prophet-6/). No HDMI/SDI/DisplayPort/USB-speed/Ethernet ports are present, so no "grade" fields apply per the connector table. The Prophet-6 Desktop module (DSI-1600) shares an identical I/O set per Sequential's own product copy, so this data applies to both the keyboard and desktop variants. Not rack-mountable (desktop/keyboard chassis), so rackUnits omitted. No connector type in the official taxonomy maps cleanly to "musical instrument/synthesizer," so category was set to "audio" and type to "Other" as the closest fits. The two main outputs are unbalanced 1/4" TS jacks per the manual's explicit "Unbalanced, 1/4 inch audio outputs" language; the two footswitch jacks are not explicitly labeled TS vs TRS in the manual text, but footswitch jacks of this kind are standard mono/TS — flagged here as a minor inference. USB physical connector shape (Type B) is inferred from typical rear-panel photos of this era of Sequential/DSI product, not stated verbatim in the manual text.

ports.name: USB
ports.note: Bidirectional USB MIDI, class-compliant; physical connector shape (Type B) inferred from rear-panel photos, not explicitly stated as text in manual

ports.name: Footswitch-Sequence
ports.note: Momentary footswitch input to start/stop sequencer/arpeggiator, or accepts an audio signal for tempo sync/gating

ports.name: Expression Pedal-Volume
ports.note: TRS expression pedal with variable resistor

ports.name: Expression Pedal-LP Filter
ports.note: TRS expression pedal with variable resistor, controls LP filter cutoff

ports.name: Headphones
ports.note: Stereo headphone jack, level from front-panel Master Vol knob
